Lane1_fastq – Folder containing all R1 and R2 Illumina Files
Move .fastq files to ../data/assembly and prepare for assembly
Call VHHAssembly.sh
Assembles and annotates VHHs
Keep counts throughout, and visualize databases with MASH
Create Global Set
Aggregate data from as many experiments as are relevant
Call HierarchicalClustering.sh
Infers clones on “Global” VHH database
Run Cleancluster algorithm on Global Set (Call CleanCluster.sh)
For each independent experiment, look up clonal assignments



```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(reshape2)
library(pheatmap)
```

```{r}
# Read the data
# distances <- read.table("~/Downloads/distances.tsv", header = FALSE, sep = "\t")
# distances <- read.table("~/Downloads/new_distances.tsv", header = FALSE, sep = "\t")
# distances <- read.table("~/Downloads/Impulse_Lulu_CoV_distances.tsv", header = F, sep = '\t')
# distances <- read.table("~/Downloads/MASH_Schisto_PassFail_distances.tsv", header = F, sep = '\t')

distances <- read.table("~/Downloads/MASH_NGO0265_NGO1549_distances09Jul24.tsv", header = F, sep = '\t')



# Assign column names for clarity
colnames(distances) <- c("Genome1", "Genome2", "Mash_Distance", "P_value", "Shared_Kmers")


# file_path <- "/cluster/tufts/cowenlab/emosel01/data/assembly/"
#file_path <- "/cluster/tufts/cowenlab/emosel01/data/hclust/"
#file_path <- "/cluster/tufts/cowenlab/emosel01/data/2024_TUCF_7981/"
file_path <- "/cluster/tufts/cowenlab/emosel01/data/assembled2/"

distances$Genome1 <- gsub(file_path, "", distances$Genome1)
distances$Genome2 <- gsub(file_path, "", distances$Genome2)

# _atleast-1.fasta
# _db-pass.fasta
suffix <- ".fasta"

distances$Genome1 <- gsub(suffix, "", distances$Genome1)
distances$Genome2 <- gsub(suffix, "", distances$Genome2)




# Create a matrix of distances
distance_matrix <- reshape2::acast(distances, Genome1 ~ Genome2, value.var = "Mash_Distance")
distance_matrix[is.na(distance_matrix)] <- 0  # Replace NAs with 0 for self-comparisons
```

## Heatmap

```{r}
# Plot the heatmap
pheatmap(distance_matrix, 
         cluster_rows = T,#TRUE, 
         cluster_cols = T,#TRUE, 
         display_numbers = T,#,TRUE,
         number_color = "white",
         color = colorRampPalette(c("red", "blue"))(50),
         main = "MASH Distance Heatmap - Schistosome Databases")
```

## PCA

```{r}
# Perform PCA
pca <- prcomp(distance_matrix, scale. = TRUE)

# Create a data frame for plotting
pca_df <- data.frame(PC1 = pca$x[,1], 
                     PC2 = pca$x[,2], 
                     Genome = rownames(pca$x))
pca_df$pass_fail <- ifelse(grepl("pass", pca_df$Genome), "PASS", "FAIL")
```


```{r}
# Plot PCA
ggplot(pca_df, aes(x = PC1, y = PC2, 
                   label = Genome, 
                   colour = pass_fail)) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  geom_text(size = 4, vjust = -1.5)+#, position=position_jitter(width = 0.50)) + #, height = 0.5)) +#, height = 0.1)) +
  ggtitle("PCA Plot of VHH Genome Distances") +
  xlab("Principal Component 1") +
  ylab("Principal Component 2") +
  theme_minimal()
```

## UMAP

```{r}
#install.packages("umap")
library("umap")

# Perform UMAP
umap_result <- umap(distance_matrix)

# Create a data frame for plotting
umap_df <- data.frame(Dim1 = umap_result$layout[,1], Dim2 = umap_result$layout[,2], Genome = rownames(distance_matrix))

# Plot UMAP
ggplot(umap_df, aes(x = Dim1, y = Dim2, label = Genome)) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  geom_text(vjust = -1) +
  ggtitle("UMAP Plot of Genome Distances") +
  xlab("Dimension 1") +
  ylab("Dimension 2") +
  theme_minimal()
```

## Hclust

```{r}
# Perform hierarchical clustering
hc <- hclust(as.dist(distance_matrix), method = "complete")

# Plot dendrogram
plot(hc, labels = rownames(distance_matrix), main = "Hierarchical Clustering Dendrogram", sub = "", xlab = "", ylab = "Distance")
```

## Multi-dimensional Scaling

```{r}
# Perform MDS
mds <- cmdscale(as.dist(distance_matrix), k = ncol(distance_matrix) - 1)

# Convert to a data frame for plotting
mds_df <- as.data.frame(mds)
mds_df$Genome <- rownames(mds_df)

# Plot MDS
ggplot(mds_df, aes(x = V1, y = V1, label = Genome)) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  geom_text(vjust = -1) +
  ggtitle("MDS Plot of Genome Distances") +
  xlab("Coordinate 1") +
  ylab("Coordinate 2") +
  theme_minimal()
```
